verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a first-party analytics capability that tracks search queries, click events, and conversions to measure search quality. However, the evidence never explicitly mentions top-query rankings, no-result query reports, or a click-through-rate view. Only the underlying tracking of queries and clicks is shown. Missing for 10: explicit top-queries report, explicit no-result-queries report, documented click-through-rate metric or dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, built-in analytics show top queries, no-result queries, and click-through so I know what users search for and miss

citations.quote: Meilisearch analytics helps you understand how users interact with your search. Track search queries, click events, and conversions to measure search quality
Track search queries, click events, and conversions to measure search quality and identify opportunities for improvement.
Track search events, user clicks, and conversions to measure and improve your search relevancy.
